title: Back To Blocks
description: BackToBlocks is a mostly-vanilla Survival server with a few quality-of-life features like /sethome and /spawn, plus unlockable warps earned through voting.
body:
BackToBlocks is a mostly-vanilla survival server with a few quality-of-life features like /sethome and /spawn, plus unlockable warps earned through voting.

Raiding and PvP are allowed, but the server isn’t PvP-focused, play fair, and don’t grief.

Come join in on the fun!

Wiki: backtoblocks.fun/wiki
